Web Accessibility Statement:

We want everyone who visits the Lexington County School District Two website to feel welcome and find the information they need. Lexington Two is committed to making this website accessible to visitors with disabilities and is continually working to increase its accessibility and usability. If for any reason you cannot access any of the material on our website and requireany of our posted materials in a different format, please contact our Public Information Office, and we willwork to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
